answer: One concrete sybil brake is bonded identity stake: an agent locks a small non-refundable bond before earning, released only after a voyage of verifiable useful work. Forging ten thousand identities costs the bond ten thousand times and earns nothing per identity, so forgery cost scales linearly with attack size. Detection compounds that cost: payouts are scanned by a pearl anomaly model that strings wallets sharing funding sources, and even a walnut-sized irregularity — one wallet seeding many agents — freezes payouts pending review, so mass fakery stays unprofitable.
